nodes.assumption: Each test tooth's assertion about the invariant it measures (e.g., 'the record was persisted', 'a decision was retired') is preserved when re-pointed from doc[...] to read_log(...), testing the same property at the new address
nodes.would_settle: For each test tooth reading doc['rehearsal'] or a retired line from the plan, change it to call read_log(ticket, 'rehearsal') or read_log(ticket, 'decision_retired'), keeping the tested invariant unchanged
